Common questions

What are the Texas Rangers' playoff odds?

They reach the 2026 postseason in 42% of 10,000 simulated finishes, win the AL West in 27%, earn a first round bye in 5% and win the World Series in 1%.

How many games will the Texas Rangers win?

They are 75 and 76 with 11 games left. The model expects about 5.6 more wins, and eight of every ten simulated finishes end between 79 and 83 wins.

How are the Rangers rated?

From runs scored and allowed: 628 scored and 670 allowed, a run differential of -42, turned into a Pythagorean record and pulled toward .500 by 70 games of average play. That rates them as a .480 team, and each game uses log5 with a home field edge.
